questionsToConsider: Which of your ranges come in many colours or styles, and which result should each sit under?
Do you offer fabric swatches or group appointments you could mention in the results?
Should weddings less than a few months away get a note about ordering and alteration times?
Is it useful to know who is paying before you recommend a price range?
guide.howToUseResponses: Sort by wedding date so parties with the least time get a reply first, since ordering and alterations take time. The party size, fit needs and who is paying tell you which ranges to show: a large group paying for their own dresses needs options at a price everyone can manage. Export to CSV to plan group appointments and see which approach most parties choose.

Edit the wedding style, length and budget options to match what your boutique offers.
Share the link with brides after their first appointment or embed it on your bridesmaid page.

faqs.a: They don't have to. Identical dresses look neat and formal, the same colour in different styles suits a mix of body shapes, and a palette of related shades feels relaxed.

faqs.q: How far in advance should bridesmaid dresses be ordered?
faqs.a: As early as you can, especially for a large group, because ordering and alterations both take time. Ask your boutique for their typical lead times.

faqs.q: What should I ask bridesmaids before choosing dresses?
faqs.a: Ask about sizes, any fit needs like pregnancy or preferring sleeves, and what they can afford if they're paying. A quiz like this collects it all in one place.

faqs.q: How does this quiz pick a result?
faqs.a: The final question about how matched the party should look leads to one of three approaches. Anyone unsure is pointed to same colour, different styles.

options.label: Same colour, each in her own style

endings.title: Mix and match a palette 🎨
endings.bodyMd: Choose three or four related shades and let each bridesmaid pick a dress within them. Keeping the length or fabric the same ties it together, and it suits relaxed, boho and outdoor weddings especially well.

endings.title: Matching dresses 👗
endings.bodyMd: One style in one colour gives the neatest photos and suits formal weddings. Choose a forgiving cut, such as a wrap or A-line, in a fabric with a little stretch so every bridesmaid is comfortable. Order early so there's time for alterations.

endings.title: Same colour, different styles 💐
endings.bodyMd: Everyone wears the same colour and fabric but picks the neckline and cut that suits her. It still looks planned in photos, and it's the easiest way to make a group of different shapes and sizes feel good. If you're unsure, this is the one we'd start with.
